optimizedDescription.value: Abstract GraphStore port for durable code-graph persistence with atomic updates, multi-axis indexing, filtered impact, and search.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules
- Abstract `GraphStore` port: domain persistence for files, documents, symbols, specs, relations. Hexagonal port; no I/O or schema prescriptions.
- Lifecycle: `open()` before operations; `close()` releases locks; `isOpen()` checks state.
- File-level atomic updates: `upsertFile` replaces file, symbols, relations, observations in single transaction.
- Query methods: `findSymbols`, `getSymbolsByIds`, `getFilesByPaths`, `getSpecsByIds`, `getIncomingSymbolRelations`, `getOutgoingSymbolRelations`, `getCoveringSpecsForFile`, `getCoveringSpecsForSymbol`.
- Filtered impact: backend-neutral criteria (types, kinds, workspace inclusions/exclusions, direction, depth). Applied at backend level, never filtered post-fetch.
- Reverse coverage: batch file paths & symbol IDs -> `COVERS_FILE` / `COVERS_SYMBOL`.
- Member-semantics persistence: lookups by structured fields (workspace, surface, name, symbol space, owner id, MemberSemantics). `qualified_name` equality lookup for owned symbols; no full-text/alias tables for qualified names.
- Logical-symbol coverage endpoints: `COVERS_SYMBOL` links spec ID to logical symbol ID; rejects missing endpoints.
- Source-content candidates: query over `FileNode.content`; substring-capable index for >=3 chars with bounded fallback.
- Incompatible store handling: reject reads on schema mismatch; recreate with full rebuild and rotated generation marker.
- Indexed-input freshness: persist `IndexedInputObservation` records; atomic monotonic latches (`knownStaleSinceLastIndex`).
- Single-session bulk indexing: chunked session with single commit and index rebuild.

## Constraints
- Abstract class, not interface.
- Atomic file-level mutations.
- `StoreNotOpenError` when closed.
- No direct `@specd/core` dependency; errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
- No prescribed physical storage engine.
